title: New Anthropic key for the VPS

steps.instruction: If the Claude Console asks you to sign in, sign in as mw@mike-wolf.com. The API keys page opens next.
Type the name vps-hermes-2026-11b. If there is a workspace menu, leave it on Default. Then click Add (or Create Key) in the dialog.
Click Copy Key so the new key is on your clipboard, then close the dialog. Optional: delete the unused key vps-hermes-2026-11 from the list. Claude installs it on the VPS right after.
